original: Good evening, Dr. Fritzliebe! How is ze Überkämpfer project coming along?
Excellently, Herr Sturmbannführer! Ze prisoners are responding exceedingly vell to ze formula. Soon ze Führer vill have his unstoppable army!
Vat's that, doctor?
I said, HEIL HITLER!
HEIL HITLER!
Verdammt! An Allied air strike!
(And soon ze Führer himself vill cower before Fritzliebe! Ha-ha!)
Mein Gott! Stop them!
Fear not! My anti-aircraft system vill deal with them shortly!
Still... zese old cellars are in poor condition. Raus!!
Castle Sonnenfreude\nSomewhere in Austria\nDecember 1943
Again, from ze top! Und more feeling zis time!
SS Officer
Nein, nein, nein! Too late again!
O Tannenbaum, o Tannenbaum,\nwie treu sind deine Blätter!
Chorus
Du grünst nicht nur zur Sommerzeit,\nNein auch im Winter, wenn es schneit!
Verdammt! Wo ist der Aufzug?
Das ist unfair!
NEIN! Du darfst den Weihnachtsbaum nicht zerstören!
Attentaten!!!
BIOCHEMIE is my specialty, it's true...
Dr. Fritzliebe
...but I have also many MECHANISCHE advancements to show you!
Ha! Ve shall see!
Impudent fools!
*cough* Arrrrrgh... Schweinhunden! You have killed me... but you vill not escape here alive!
Die now!
There she goes, boys. Mission accomplished.
Someone's coming out, sir!
Nevermind, you can tell me later. My orders are to get you the hell out of here!
If what I've heard is true, you just might be what we need to win this war...
RARRRRRRRRH!!
Kriegbär #2
HNNNARRRRRRRHHH!
Ah, my children... you have killed poor Kriegbär #2.
You are my greatest triumph... but also my greatest mistake!
It is time I rectify that mistake! I vill take you apart, start again. And the next model vill be better. It vill OBEY.
I vill have to take you apart and start again. And this time you vill be perfect!
Ah, children! You've come so far. How proud it makes me. You really are my greatest scientific TRIUMPH!
But also my greatest MISTAKE! It is time to rectify that mistake. Frau Sturmbannführer! Bring zem to me!
Hm! Ze Kriegbär has escaped? That bodes ill for you, my friend!
Ah, my child! You've come so far. How proud it makes me. You really are my greatest scientific TRIUMPH!
But also my greatest MISTAKE! It is time to rectify that mistake. Frau Sturmbannführer! Bring ze specimen to me!
Hm! Ze Kriegbär has escaped? That bodes ill for you, my Lieblings!
Ah, poor Kriegbär #2! He vas one of my favorite creatures. Oh vell... I admit defeat. Come in, and let us discuss the terms of my surrender!
You don't look like Nazis - how the hell did you get out alive?
You don't look like a Nazi - how the hell did you get out alive?
Urrrgh...
Where the hell...?
Oh, right... Nazis.
Urrrgh... my head...
What are you? German? British?
American. And you, lady? Russian, right?
Da. I remember being captured... tortured...
Mon dieu... What the hell is going on?
I don't know, but I'm not going back in one of those tanks.
Me too. But where are we... How...?
I don't know, but I'm gonna find out.
Da... where are we?
I don't know, but I'm not sticking around.
The symbol of the Six-Sided Sun... so we are in the hands of the SSS.
Hell...
What do you know about them?
Only that they are Nazis. The worst kind.
Fair enough. Then you have some idea of what we're up against.
That's no regular Nazi flag. What is this?
They call it 'Die Sechs-Seitige Sonne'. It's bad news.
What do you know about the SSS?
A secret society within the Reich. Secret research - weapons, bio-engineering, the occult...
Jeez. And here I thought regular Nazis were bad enough.
Is there an air raid going on? That might give me a chance...
Is there an air raid going on? Could be our chance of escape...
I fear our chances are somewhat slim.
Is there a way up to the surface?
You won't take me alive, you devils!
I feel... different. Stronger... What the hell did that crazy doctor do to me?
I feel... different. Stronger... more durable.
...Angrier.
I believe they had a notion of turning human beings into weapons.
Guess they should've thought twice.
These Nazis don't put up much of a fight, do they?
Strange... I was never much of a fighter, but now I feel unstoppable!
I too feel in excellent physical condition...
Must be all those vitamins they made us swim in...
I'll ask the head scientist while I squeeze his Nazi neck!
What the hell did they do to me? I feel like I could lift a truck!
I'll ask that scientist who tortured us... while I squeeze his Nazi neck!
Guess they kept our old clothes.
What the hell was that!
Give it up, Fritzliebe! We've destroyed all your toys!
Glad we're on the same side. I'm Lt. Eugene McBride, US Army.
Sgt. Irina Petrovska, Red Army.
Marcel Marie, French Resistance.
Uh-oh. What's that noise?
You fought well back there. I am Sgt. Irina Petrovska.
Enchanté, madame. Marcel Marie, French Resistance.
Lt. Eugene McBride, US Army...
Shhh! Listen! What's that?
Allow me to introduce myself... Marcel Marie, French Resistance.
Lt. Eugene McBride. American.
Sgt. Irina Petrovska. Russia.
Shh! I thought I heard something...
Incoming!
Here they come!
Nazis!
Look out!
What about you, tough guy? What do they call you?
Me? My name...
...is Stave Rygur.
That's not a real name!
Suit yourself.
Cannons... that crazy doctor mentioned some kind of... anti-air system. If the cannons were destroyed, maybe the bombers have a chance...
Nice and easy now...
No way the bombers are getting through THAT kind of fire. I don't like it... but let's see about those cannons.
I need a hand grenade...
Damn noise! Gotta kill those cannons!
Better lob a grenade in the barrel.
A grenade down the barrel oughtta shut those cannons up...
We have to blow them up from the INSIDE!
A hand grenade down the throat will kill anything!
Anybody got a grenade?
Gotta destroy those cannons!
A grenade in the barrel oughtta do the trick!
Destroy the cannons! A grenade in the barrel ought to do it.
Destroy the cannons by throwing a grenade down the barrel!
Try throwing the grenades INTO the cannons!
That works! Two cannons to go!
One cannon left!
That's all the cannons gone! The bombers can get through now!
Bring on the bombs! Though I'd like to get below ground first...
Good job! I don't know about you, but I'd like to get below ground.
Aaaaaaaah!
That was... rough. But I'm not dead yet.
That was... rough. How long was I unconscious?
There's snow... but no sun. It must be night outside.
Should we wait here? Maybe they'll rescue us.
No. Let us go on. This castle isn't dead yet.
What makes you say that?
Argh!!!
I have to get that door open! That valve looks right...
Get that door open! Try the valve!
We need to get through that door! Try the valve!
Open that door! Try the valve!
Try that red valve!
Door is open! Gotta get inside!
The door is open! Get inside!
Get inside! Quick!
Hurry, through the door!
Go, go! The door is open!
Now how the hell do I close the door!
Close the door!
Second valve! Close the door!
Get that door closed!
Close the door! That'll keep them out!
The door is closed! They can't get in!
You can't get through now, you rotten bastards!
Door closed!
They can't get through THAT!
It works! The door is closed!
